notes: Stories created for proximity measure using existing Google Routes integration.

stories.title: Define Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define structured schema for clinical trial proximity including distance (miles/km), travel duration (minutes), origin, destination, and calculation metadata to ensure consistent downstream consumption.

stories.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Calculation Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to compute distance and travel time between user location and each clinical trial site using Google Routes API, including batching and fallback handling for missing coordinates.

stories.title: Integrate Proximity Metrics into Clinical Trial Results
stories.description: Attach computed proximity metrics to each trial location in the clinical trials service output and ensure compatibility with existing trial formatting and ranking logic.

stories.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Ensure proximity metrics are surfaced through evaluate_care_facade and available to the chat response layer with clear field naming and formatting.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculations
stories.description: Create unit tests for distance/time computation logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from trial search through proximity enrichment, including edge cases like missing user location or invalid routes.
